STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_1.title: Setting Out
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_1.description:
Navia, president of Spina di Rosula in Poisson — a warm-hearted, reliable young lady forever racing to the front lines of adventure to help anyone in need.
When word arrived that the Spire had opened, the spirit of adventure took hold of her at once.
She brought her most trusted retainers, shouldered her umbrella-shotgun, and set out for the tower.
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_1.unlockText: Unlock: Navia becomes a playable character.
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_1.unlock: Navia has arrived at the Spire.
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_2.title: The Blight
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_2.description:
From Neow, Navia learned of the Blight's existence. No dangerous plague could curb the young lady's curiosity.
"Alright then, let's go see for ourselves how terrible this Blight is — maybe we'll even find friends who need help! Clorinde, you really should see this perilous Spire!"
Without hesitation, she began her expedition.
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_3.title: Curiosity
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_3.description:
Navia sent a letter to her friends back in Fontaine.
"The Spire is such a dangerous, delightful place! My friends, you simply must come see it!"
Enclosed were photos of her with all manner of giant monsters — a colossal statue with a scythe, a coral-wrapped humanoid, and... a strange wriggling worm?
It takes real courage to pose for photos with such things.
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_3.unlockInfo: Defeat 3 bosses as Navia in total.
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_4.title: The Top of the Spire
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_4.description:
At the very top of the Spire, Navia met the man called the Architect.
Next to his coldness, her warmth stood out — awkward, but timely. She shared her journey's stories and asked about the Spire's many tales.
But the Architect seemed unwilling to answer. Again and again, he sent Navia back to the bottom of the tower.
STS2_NAVIA_EPOCH_4.unlockInfo: Win an Ascension 1 run as Navia.
